text:
Happy first Sunday back on standard time. It's a clear, sunny late morning with temperatures in the upper 40s, and the sun is doing its job. This afternoon climbs to a high near 57, a few degrees milder than yesterday felt. With sunset coming around 4:40 now, the best window for a walk or a ride is between noon and 3, before the light fades and it cools off quickly. A light jacket will do.

Tonight brings a few clouds and a low around 40, so it's not as cold as recent mornings. Monday looks mostly sunny and warmer, with a high near 62. A couple of the models push it into the mid 60s, and I'd lean toward the warmer side.

Tuesday is the one to watch. Clouds thicken, and a little light rain is possible late in the day, though it would be a sprinkle at most and not every model even has it. Wednesday is the real surprise, with highs in the upper 60s and maybe low 70s, and a gusty south breeze to go with it. The rain that matters arrives Thursday.

Cooler and mostly cloudy, high near 61, with on-and-off rain possible and a chilly 43 by night.
